scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: bun run build:backend && bun run build:frontend
scripts.lint: bun run lint:backend && bun run lint:frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "cd backend && npm start" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.db:reseed: docker compose exec -T mysql mysql -uroot -pticketrush_secret ticketrush < database/seeds/001_seed_data.sql
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
